attributes._cssText: body { margin: 0px; font-family: Georgia, serif; color: rgb(43, 33, 24); background: rgb(250, 246, 240); }header { background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgb(74, 44, 23), rgb(139, 90, 43)); color: rgb(245, 233, 217); padding: 48px 64px; }header h1 { margin: 0px 0px 8px; font-size: 42px; }header p { margin: 0px; font-size: 18px; opacity: 0.85; }nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 14px 64px; background: rgb(46, 28, 14); }nav a { color: rgb(232, 217, 195); text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }main { padding: 40px 64px; }.cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 24px; }.card { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 1px solid rgb(224, 213, 197); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; }.card h3 { margin: 0px 0px 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }.price { color: rgb(139, 90, 43); font-weight: bold; font-size: 20px; }.process { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgb(138, 122, 102); border: 1px solid rgb(216, 201, 180); border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; }.card a.view { display: inline-block; margin-top: 12px; background: rgb(74, 44, 23); color: rgb(245, 233, 217); padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none; }.ribbon { background: rgb(240, 228, 210); border-left: 4px solid rgb(139, 90, 43); padding: 16px 24px; margin: 32px 0px; font-style: italic; }footer { padding: 24px 64px; color: rgb(138, 122, 102); border-top: 1px solid rgb(224, 213, 197); margin-top: 48px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }.toast { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; background: rgb(46, 28, 14); color: rgb(245, 233, 217); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 6px; display: none; }

childNodes.textContent: Small-batch roasters since 2019 — roasted Tuesdays, shipped Wednesdays.
Eighteen single-origin lots on the shelf this week, roasted in 12-kilo batches and shipped within 48 hours of the roast date. Every bag carries its roast day, lot number, and the curve we used.
Free shipping on orders over $40. Subscribers save 10% and pick their grind.
Washed process from smallholder lots in the Huila highlands. Caramel sweetness up front, red apple acidity, a round chocolate body that holds up through the cool-down.
Natural process, raised-bed dried. Blueberry jam and jasmine on the nose, syrupy body, a long floral finish that rewards a slightly cooler brew.
Sugarcane EA decaffeination done in origin country. Cocoa and dried fig, gentle acidity, none of the cardboard flatness cheap decaf settles for.
A washed Ethiopian with bergamot and black tea notes. Tightrope balance between brightness and body; our roasters' staff pick three months running.
Volcanic soil terroir you can taste: dark chocolate, subtle smoke, orange zest. Classic comfort profile roasted a shade past medium.
Blackcurrant and grapefruit with that unmistakable Kenyan savory depth. Screen-18 beans, double fermented, roasted bright on purpose.
From the Jaramillo slopes that made the varietal famous. Honeysuckle, papaya, bergamot — extravagant and worth it once in a while.
Giling basah processed, earthy and heavy. Dark cocoa, cedar, a brown-sugar sweetness that makes an outstanding flat white.
Pulped natural from a fourth-generation fazenda. Hazelnut, milk chocolate, low acidity — the backbone of our espresso blend, solo here.
Honey process, white-honey grade. Stone fruit and raw almond with a clean cane-sugar finish. Brews forgivingly at any ratio.
High-altitude Guatemalan washed lot. Toffee, baked apple, a quiet floral edge; the roast curve keeps the sugars just short of caramelized.
Wet-hulled and sun-dried on volcanic terraces. Mandarin and dark caramel; an unusual cup that converts skeptics of island coffees.
Washed heirloom varietals, garden grown. Lemon candy, honey, light black-tea body. Our brightest offering this season.
Organic certified co-op lot near the Guatemalan border. Toasted walnut, baker's chocolate, gentle malic acidity. A dependable daily cup.
Triple-picked wet-hulled lot. Forest floor, dark spice, bittersweet chocolate; the heaviest body on this list by a margin.
Washed bourbon from a women-led cooperative. Cranberry, clove, brown butter; one of the most distinctive lots we have ever shelved.
Giant-bean Pacamara, washed. Lime leaf, vanilla, creamy body — a cupping-table favorite that survived to a production roast.
Hand-sorted peaberries from Kilimanjaro slopes. Winey acidity, dark berry, molasses; small beans, concentrated cup.

childNodes.textContent: Washed process — caramel, red apple, round body.

Grown between 1,600 and 1,900 meters by smallholders around Pitalito, this lot is fully washed and dried on covered patios. We roast it to the edge of medium — far enough to develop the caramel, short enough to keep the apple acidity alive. It has been the anchor of our lineup for three seasons because it does everything well: pour-over, press, espresso, even cold brew.
"The apple note is real — bright but never sour. My daily pour-over for two months now." — Dana K.
"Pulled as espresso it goes full caramel. Forgiving even when my grinder isn't." — Marcus T.
"Bought one bag at the Saturday cupping, came back for six." — Priya S.
